name: Key Packaging Co
old_description: YOUR KEY PARTNER FOR CUSTOM INNOVATIVE THERMOFORMING SOLUTIONS
about:
Key Packaging Co operates from Sarasota, Florida, providing custom thin-gauge thermoforming solutions for plastic packaging. The company offers integrated design, prototyping, mold building, and thermoforming services under one roof.

Its manufacturing capabilities include design and prototyping, mold and tool building, thermoforming production, supply chain management, and quality assurance. The company produces a variety of packaging products such as protective and shipping trays for automotive and industrial components, medical device packaging, pharmaceutical packaging, cosmetic packaging, retail packaging, electronic packaging, and food packaging.

Key Packaging serves customers in the medical, automotive, pharmaceutical, cosmetic, retail, electronics, and food industries. Specific applications include medical device trays, automotive component shipping trays, and consumer product packaging for retail and cosmetic markets.

The company differentiates itself through a corporate commitment to Lean Six Sigma methodology, employing both Black Belt and Green Belt personnel to drive process excellence. It holds ISO 9001:2015 certification and operates a ship-to-stock program that allows qualified customers to receive products without incoming inspection.
